answer: Here is one concrete wall: Vehicle registration history with transport authority attestation. It works because a vehicle registered to one owner for years, and the bridge it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the wander is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. Time is the tax here: a vehicle registered to one owner for years cannot be rushed or parallelised beyond a point, so the horizon for a farm is a calendar it cannot buy its way out of.
